findings.evidence: No consolidated Phase 1/2 business-rule source or explicit external evidence locator was found in the repository.
findings.root_cause: The historical rule corpus is outside this repository snapshot or was never imported as a canonical index.
findings.impact: The audit cannot prove completeness against the earliest business authority.
findings.remediation_scope: Identify the authoritative Phase 1/2 corpus and bind it read-only before rationalization.
findings.test_strategy: Manifest the source and verify every imported rule has authority and lineage.

findings.evidence: The README requires legacy reuse to be traced in docs/legacy-review, while Phase 12.15 records an adapted Phase 7 implementation and the required directory is absent.
findings.root_cause: The reuse evidence was recorded in a phase handoff rather than the mandated trace location.
findings.impact: Legacy provenance cannot be verified through the repository's own declared process.
findings.remediation_scope: Decide the authoritative trace location and reconcile the already-declared Phase 7 reuse without rewriting history.
findings.test_strategy: Add a documentary lineage check only after owner disposition.

findings.evidence: Resource Library READ-15 is the only concrete Domain/Application slice; other business module paths are scaffolds while route metadata exists.
findings.root_cause: Architecture and runtime contracts were established before the remaining business use cases.
findings.impact: Routes can be mistaken for implemented business capabilities and adapters can become de facto owners.
findings.remediation_scope: Prioritize concrete Application owners for read-production, deterministic validation and promotion.
findings.test_strategy: Contract and use-case tests must precede adapter/API tests.

findings.evidence: There are no concrete /api/v2 endpoint files. Eleven rules are API-relevant, eight stop at contract boundaries and three have no API implementation.
findings.root_cause: HTTP delivery remains projected rather than implemented.
findings.impact: Business capabilities are not exposed through the projected transport surface.
findings.remediation_scope: Choose the /api/v2 delivery slice only after concrete Application owners exist.
findings.test_strategy: Endpoint contract, validation and no-direct-store architecture tests.

findings.location: external canonical SQLite seed referenced by Phase 12.15 and 12.17.1
findings.evidence: Nine raw rules require constraints from the reported 98-table schema, whose DDL is not in the repository.
findings.root_cause: The seed is intentionally external and was not bound as read-only evidence for this audit.
findings.impact: Data-model equivalence, status constraints, keys and indexes cannot be fully verified.
findings.remediation_scope: Authorize a read-only, hash-bound schema comparison; do not copy the database into Git.
findings.test_strategy: Schema-only introspection against the exact authorized seed with no mutation.

findings.evidence: Ten status/type/title/actor/default literal families are implemented in the adapter without a consolidated Domain/Application vocabulary.
findings.root_cause: The generic persistence contract was built before the corresponding business aggregates and enums.
findings.impact: Adapter defaults can silently define lifecycle semantics and drift from future domain rules.
findings.remediation_scope: Assign each vocabulary to a business owner before moving or validating literals.
findings.test_strategy: Domain transition and adapter conformance tests after ownership is decided.

findings.evidence: Read-production, validation, quality and promotion representations exist in infrastructure/runtime contracts without concrete business use-case owners.
findings.root_cause: Cross-cutting runtime scaffolding precedes the bounded application modules.
findings.impact: A technical success state may be confused with validation or promotion authority.
findings.remediation_scope: Define authoritative commands/queries and transition ownership before transport expansion.
findings.test_strategy: Negative authority tests plus use-case-level transition tests.

findings.evidence: Version-specific V4/V5.x live guards, carry-forward and incident recovery rules remain beside general calibration invariants; live authorization is consumed and release threshold is NONE.
findings.root_cause: Incident-driven calibration hardening accumulated in executable test tooling and closure evidence.
findings.impact: Historical controls can be mistaken for production business policy or retained indefinitely without a general contract.
findings.remediation_scope: Retain immutable evidence, extract general invariants and decide deprecation of version-specific policy in a later phase.
findings.test_strategy: No 12.17.4 change in this lot; later prove semantic equivalence before consolidation.

findings.evidence: Two exact duplicate groups exist: DG-EXACT-01 and DG-EXACT-02, each with two occurrences.
findings.root_cause: The same repository policies are repeated in user-facing and agent-facing control documents.
findings.impact: Independent edits can create divergent governance instructions.
findings.remediation_scope: Name one source of truth and retain references at enforcement surfaces.
findings.test_strategy: Document parity or reference integrity check.

findings.location: rule register across Application, runtime, security, persistence and calibration
findings.evidence: Eight quasi-duplicate groups are enumerated: DG-Q-01 through DG-Q-08, covering 22 rule occurrences.
findings.root_cause: Shared invariants are repeated at multiple boundaries without a normalized rule catalogue.
findings.impact: Semantically equivalent checks can evolve different codes, statuses or exceptions.
findings.remediation_scope: Centralize vocabulary and authority references without removing defence-in-depth validation blindly.
findings.test_strategy: Equivalence tests for normalized outcomes at every retained boundary.

findings.evidence: Nine overlap clusters are enumerated: governance, Application boundary, lifecycle, persistence, authority, security, recovery, observability and calibration.
findings.root_cause: Rules were delivered phase-by-phase and optimized for local gates rather than one product-wide taxonomy.
findings.impact: Extensions and exceptions can be attached to different formulations of the same core invariant.
findings.duplication_group: OC-GOVERNANCE; OC-APPLICATION_BOUNDARY; OC-LIFECYCLE; OC-PERSISTENCE; OC-AUTHORITY; OC-SECURITY; OC-RECOVERY; OC-OBSERVABILITY; OC-CALIBRATION
findings.remediation_scope: Adopt shared parent rules and keep bounded extensions explicit.
findings.test_strategy: Parent/extension/exception traceability checks.

findings.location: backend Python validators and 12.17.1 source inventory
findings.evidence: The inventory found 156 private validator methods and 16 duplicate-name groups containing 50 definitions; name equality does not prove semantic redundancy.
findings.root_cause: Validation is intentionally local to many contracts but lacks a cross-boundary semantic index.
findings.impact: Unreviewed consolidation could remove required fail-closed checks, while no consolidation risks drift.
findings.remediation_scope: Compare preconditions, error semantics and authority per duplicate-name group.
findings.test_strategy: Mutation/negative tests at each boundary before any move.

findings.location: 89 files containing 172 enum classes in the 12.17.1 inventory
findings.evidence: Enum vocabulary is widely distributed across modules, runtime contracts, tests and calibration tooling.
findings.root_cause: Each delivery phase introduced bounded local contracts without a global semantic ownership map.
findings.impact: Equal-looking statuses can have different authority or lifecycle meaning.
findings.remediation_scope: Separate business vocabulary from transport, runtime and calibration enums before deduplication.
findings.test_strategy: Serialization and transition compatibility tests per owner.

findings.evidence: READ-15 version_ref and include are explicitly deferred and have neither implementation nor tests.
findings.root_cause: The delivered slice intentionally implemented logical resource lookup only.
findings.impact: Consumers may assume projected options exist unless the contract remains explicit.
findings.remediation_scope: Do not implement until owner scope is chosen.
findings.test_strategy: If retained as unsupported, add an explicit contract rejection test in a future implementation lot.

findings.evidence: The Phase 11.17 scenario-number table is explicitly marked legacy and inconsistent for WF-3 through WF-11.
findings.root_cause: Workflow names evolved after the earlier numbered table.
findings.impact: Readers or generators can select obsolete workflow semantics.
findings.remediation_scope: Keep historical trace but direct all authority to the canonical workflow catalog.
findings.test_strategy: Catalog identity and count tests already provide structural coverage.

findings.location: BR-060, BR-061 and Phase 12.16 closure evidence
findings.evidence: Ten raw rules are over-specific overall; calibration rules BR-060 and BR-061 retain V4/V5.x live/carry-forward incident details and BR-062 is a closure-specific no-threshold state.
findings.root_cause: Fail-closed repairs were versioned and preserved as historical evidence.
findings.impact: Temporary remediation mechanics can obscure stable business semantics.
findings.remediation_scope: Preserve manifests and outcomes; separate reusable policy from consumed authorization details.
findings.test_strategy: Semantic equivalence tests before any archival move.

findings.evidence: Authority and supersession are inferable across ADRs and handoffs but there is no single rule authority index.
findings.root_cause: Canonical evidence is phase-oriented rather than rule-oriented.
findings.impact: Auditors must reconstruct precedence and can misclassify apparent contradictions.
findings.remediation_scope: Publish an owner-approved source/authority/supersedes index after decisions.
findings.test_strategy: Manifest and referential-integrity validation.

findings.evidence: Eight raw rules have no explicit or structural test; explicit-or-structural coverage is 58/66 (87.9%).
findings.root_cause: Governance rules and projected/unowned features do not yet have executable acceptance contracts.
findings.impact: Policy drift or accidental claims of implementation may go undetected.
findings.remediation_scope: Use documentary tests for governance and behavioural tests only after implementation authorization.
findings.test_strategy: One traceability assertion per approved candidate plus negative behaviour tests.

findings.evidence: No executable TODO/FIXME/XXX marker was found; two textual/documentary occurrences were clues only and were not treated as authority.
findings.root_cause: No defect; this records the audit's evidence discipline.
findings.impact: Without this boundary, comments could be promoted incorrectly into canonical rules.
findings.remediation_scope: None in this phase.
findings.test_strategy: Repeat discovery scan in future audits.

findings.location: Domain/Application contracts, adapters, phase handoffs and API projection documents
findings.evidence: Data and API mappings are distributed; only five raw rules have a locally verified data mapping and no HTTP endpoint closes the API trace.
findings.root_cause: Traceability was delivered per vertical phase and external schema evidence is separate.
findings.impact: Impact analysis requires manual joins across rule, code, schema and transport evidence.
findings.remediation_scope: Create a verified mapping index after external schema and API scope decisions.
findings.test_strategy: Referential integrity and endpoint-to-use-case mapping checks.
